cues: Perception, not charity: describing people only by what they lack is itself part of what keeps them poor.
Solidarity: richly linked in hope, one rope, one fate.
And the dignity of the poor: their work, wisdom and creativity, not our pity.
You may apply the poem to Nepali workers abroad, but say honestly that you are applying it.
